author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a dog's head in profile looking up-left with a floppy ear lobe, a chest and neck, and a raised front paw reaching toward a small ball in the corner; follows the reference's composition. The drawing is still quite abstract at 48 px (as the reference is). A first attempt without the ear (attempts/v1-no-ear.svg) read as a letter. The rejected drawing was a disconnected zigzag with a ring.
omissions: The ball is smaller than the reference (r3 ring) so the snout can clear it by 8; the reference's rear body line is dropped.
drawing_plan: SQUARE: head contour ear front (33,20)-(33,26), r4 ear bottom about (37,26), ear back x41, r8 skull about (33,14) to (33,6), snout top to (21,10), nose to (21,16), jaw to (25,18); neck (37,30)-(42,42); chest (25,27)-(25,42); raised leg (25,32)-(14,30)-(9,22); ball r3 at (9,9).
lucide_reference: No Lucide dog profile; quarter-arc skull and circle ball follow Lucide construction.
